senses.gloss:
हुर्च्छ् r. 1st cl. (हूर्च्छति)
 1. To be crooked, (literally.)
 2. To be fraudulent,
(figuratively.)
 3. To retreat, to hide or abscond.

हूरव m. (-वः) A Jackal.
 E. हू a cry of fear or wrath, and ख sound.

हूर्च्छन n. (-नं)
 1. Crookedness, (literal.)
 2. Craft, cunning, (figurative.)
E. हुर्च्छ् to be crooked, ल्युट् aff.
